authorization: Owner requested R2 energy evaluation after G-3a prime sanity checkpoint
scope: Eight original O1 parents only, seed 11; exploratory CPU full solves and unrelaxed MACE single points

arms.R2: 250 delivered-score iRprop+ steps, no Adam, fallback delta0=.01
arms.R2_minus: 250 delivered-score iRprop- steps, no Adam; same .01 initial step, bounds and stopping rule as R2

reproduction: Same default eight-chunk layout; bound executor concurrency to five. Verify delivered top1 scores against g3prime_r2.json before interpreting energies. Save all returned coordinates and symbols from each conf.complex.atoms, with explicit equality assertions.
primary: Paired top1 unrelaxed energy difference R2 minus C0; mean with parent-clustered bootstrap 95% CI and median, all eight parents. Energies relative to correctly labelled frame reference.
secondary: per-parent top1 energies and score changes
obscene rate >200 kJ/mol across all delivered rows
solver time, noting different iteration counts
interpretation: Exploratory eight-parent check, no production adoption or panel pass claim. Report score-up/energy-up inversions. No tuning against results.
failure_policy: Record each parent/arm failure and continue; no imputation. Reproduction failures invalidate the corresponding comparison.
amendment: Owner additionally requested iRprop- afterwards; fixed before any minus-arm results.
irprop_minus: Igel/Huesken 2003 section2.4/Fig3: on sign flip shrink delta, zero update and stored gradient; no weight backtracking; everything else identical to plus
additional_comparison: R2_minus versus both paired R2 and C0, same primary and secondary metrics; descriptive eight-parent follow-up, no tuning or adoption gate.
